name: Cisco WWAI Multi-Agent Platform
summary: Led the architecture of an AI workforce-planning platform at enterprise scale — a LangGraph multi-agent system with a routing layer that dispatches each request to a domain-specialised agent.
detail: The LLM never touches the data. It parameterises calls; the platform executes them, so every action stays auditable. ~2M records in under five seconds, and a multi-day planning cycle became hours.
